components.name: Control/Button
components.description: Use one primary action per view. Secondary supports nearby actions; Quiet is for low-emphasis actions. Five states, 40 px height, visible focus. Label is editable.

components.name: Control/Icon button
components.description: Compact 40 px action. Swap the icon property and supply an accessible label in implementation. Preview plays a short sample without changing the active preset.

components.name: Control/Switch
components.description: Use beside a persistent text label. 48 by 44 hit area. Space toggles. Disabled controls remain readable and do not accept input.

components.name: Control/Slider
components.description: Volume from 0 to 100. Pair with visible value. Arrow keys change by 1, Shift + arrow by 10. 44 px hit height. Values are illustrative Figma variants.

components.name: Control/Search
components.description: Persistent accessible label: Search sound library. Empty, filled, focused, error and disabled states. Pair error state with explanatory text; do not rely on red alone.

components.name: Navigation/Tab
components.description: Selected state uses weight and surface in addition to color. Arrow keys move between tabs. Keep labels visible.

components.name: Library/Sound pack
components.description: Selecting a row shows details. The play button previews a fixed comparison sample. Apply preset is a separate explicit action. Missing audio exposes a repair action in the details pane.

components.name: Feedback/Status
components.description: Always explain why sound is paused. Resume is visible beside an automatic pause. Error includes a recovery action. Status is conveyed by text as well as color.

components.name: Keyboard/Keycap
components.description: Original OpenKlack keycap. Subtle physical travel, no scale bounce. Press state uses accent and a shorter lower edge. Resize horizontally for logical keys.

components.name: Keyboard/OpenKlack 60
components.description: Original keyboard illustration built from linked keycap instances. Visual reference for the native 3D keyboard. Animate only while the settings view is visible.

components.name: Feedback/Empty state
components.description: One clear next action. Explain the permission purpose without implying access has already been granted. Empty search preserves the query and offers a reset.
